arxiv-2202-10829.title: Bounds on new physics with data of the Dresden-II reactor experiment and COHERENT Preprint: IFT-UAM/CSIC-22-10 YITP-SB-2022-03 IFIC/22-06
arxiv-2202-10829.creator: Pilar Coloma, Ivan Esteban, M.C. Gonzalez-Garcia, Leire Larizgoitia, Francesc Monrabal, Sergio Palomares-Ruiz
arxiv-2202-10829.description: Abstract Coherent elastic neutrino-nucleus scattering was first experimentally established five years ago by the COHERENT experiment using neutrinos from the spallation neutron source at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. The first evidence of observation of coherent elastic neutrino-nucleus scattering with reactor antineutrinos has now been reported by the Dresden-II reactor experiment, using a germanium detector.

arxiv-2306-00007.title: Datasets for Portuguese Legal Semantic Textual Similarity: Comparing weak supervision and an annotation process approaches
arxiv-2306-00007.creator: Daniel da Silva Junior, Paulo Roberto dos S. Corval, Aline Paes, Daniel de Oliveira
arxiv-2306-00007.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Daniel da Silva Junior, Paulo Roberto dos S. Corval, Aline Paes, Daniel de Oliveira. The Brazilian judiciary has a large workload, resulting in a long time to finish legal proceedings. Brazilian National Council of Justice has established in Resolution 469/2022 formal guidance for document and process digitalization opening up the possibility of using automatic techniques to help with everyday tasks in the legal field, particularly in a large number of texts yielded on the routine of law procedures.

arxiv-2403-10347.title: Quantum Magnetic Skyrmion Operator
arxiv-2403-10347.creator: Andreas Haller, Sebastián A. Díaz, Wolfgang Belzig, Thomas L. Schmidt
arxiv-2403-10347.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Andreas Haller, Sebastián A. Díaz, Wolfgang Belzig, Thomas L. Schmidt. We propose a variational wave function to represent quantum skyrmions as bosonic operators. The operator faithfully reproduces two fundamental features of quantum skyrmions: their classical magnetic order and a “quantum cloud” of local spin-flip excitations. Using exact numerical simulations of the ground states of a 2D chiral magnetic model, we find two regions in the single-skyrmion state diagram distinguished by their leading quantum corrections.

arxiv-2404-18375.title: Field Notes on Deploying Research Robots in Public Spaces Conference: Extended Abstracts of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; May 11–16, 2024; Honolulu, HI, USA Extended Abstracts of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI EA ’24), May 11–16, 2024, Honol
arxiv-2404-18375.creator: Fanjun Bu, Alexandra Bremers, Mark Colley, Wendy Ju
arxiv-2404-18375.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Fanjun Bu, Alexandra Bremers, Mark Colley, Wendy Ju. Human-robot interaction requires to be studied in the wild. In the summers of 2022 and 2023, we deployed two trash barrel service robots through the wizard-of-oz protocol in public spaces to study human-robot interactions in urban settings. We deployed the robots at two different public plazas in downtown Manhattan and Brooklyn for a collective of 20 hours of field time. To date, relatively few long-term human-robot interaction studies have been conducted in shared public spaces.

arxiv-2406-17619.title: The Topological Behavior of Preferential Attachment Graphs
arxiv-2406-17619.creator: Chunyin Siu
arxiv-2406-17619.description: Abstract We investigate the higher-order connectivity of scale-free networks using algebraic topology. We model scale-free networks as preferential attachment graphs, and we study the algebraic-topological properties of their clique complexes. We focus on the Betti numbers and the homotopy-connectedness of these complexes. We determine the asymptotic almost sure orders of magnitude of the Betti numbers.

arxiv-2411-14416.title: 𝖰𝖬𝖠 \mathsf{QMA} vs. 𝖰𝖢𝖬𝖠 \mathsf{QCMA} and Pseudorandomness
arxiv-2411-14416.creator: Jiahui Liu, Saachi Mutreja, Henry Yuen
arxiv-2411-14416.description: Abstract We study a longstanding question of Aaronson and Kuperberg on whether there exists a classical oracle separating 𝖰𝖬𝖠 \mathsf{QMA} from 𝖰𝖢𝖬𝖠 \mathsf{QCMA} . Settling this question in either direction would yield insight into the power of quantum proofs over classical proofs. We show that such an oracle exists if a certain quantum pseudorandomness conjecture holds.

arxiv-2507-04516.title: The planar edge-coloring theorem of Vizing in O ⁡ ( n ​ log ⁡ n ) O(n\log n) time Thanks: This paper is based on the MSc thesis of the first author [ 11 ] .
arxiv-2507-04516.creator: Patryk Jędrzejczak, Łukasz Kowalik
arxiv-2507-04516.description: Abstract In 1965, Vizing [ 16 ] showed that every planar graph of maximum degree Δ ≥ 8 \Delta\geq 8 can be edge-colored using Δ \Delta colors. The direct implementation of the Vizing’s proof gives an algorithm that finds the coloring in O ⁡ ( n 2 ) O(n^{2}) time for an n n -vertex input graph.

arxiv-2602-15255.title: Helium superluminous SN 2021bnw : an explosion of a massive star with a pre-outburst
arxiv-2602-15255.creator: Alexandra Kozyreva, Matteo Bugli, Alexey Mironov, Petr Baklanov
arxiv-2602-15255.description: Abstract Superluminous supernovae (SLSNe) remain an intriguing topic in supernova (SN) transient astronomy. While the majority of SLSNe are shown to be explained by energy streaming from the newly born magnetar, there are others which are powered by different mechanisms. We analyse the pseudo-bolometric light curve of the nearby helium-rich SLSN 2021bnw.

pmc-10585378.title: Improving near-infrared luminescence in Er3+ doped CsPbBr3 quantum dots glasses through a certain energy transfer process
pmc-10585378.creator: Kai Huang, Feng Jiao Zhao, Wen Qiang Song, Chang Yuan Xu, Hong Ming Yin
pmc-10585378.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Er3+ has received extensive attention due to its excellent optical properties, especially its emission at 1535 nm in atmospheric propagation window. Enhancement and regulation of 1535 nm emission of Er3+ is of great significance to optical communication. In this work, growing of CsPbBr3 QDs has been controlled through adjusting annealing time which would precisely regulate conduction band of CsPbBr3 QDs to match energy levels of Er3+ enabling energy transfer between Er3+ and CsPbBr3 QDs.

pmc-10604215.title: Synergistic Antimicrobial Effect of Cold Atmospheric Plasma and Redox-Active Nanoparticles
pmc-10604215.creator: Artem M Ermakov, Vera A Afanasyeva, Alexander V Lazukin, Yuri M Shlyapnikov, Elizaveta S Zhdanova, Anastasia A Kolotova, Artem S Blagodatski, Olga N Ermakova, Nikita N Chukavin, Vladimir K Ivanov, Anton L Popov, Christoph Viktor Suschek
pmc-10604215.description: Cold argon plasma (CAP) and metal oxide nanoparticles are well known antimicrobial agents. In the current study, on an example of Escherichia coli, a series of analyses was performed to assess the antibacterial action of the combination of these agents and to evaluate the possibility of using cerium oxide and cerium fluoride nanoparticles for a combined treatment of bacterial diseases.

pmc-10937436.title: Identification of FLRT2 as a key prognostic gene through a comprehensive analysis of TMB and IRGPs in BLCA patients
pmc-10937436.creator: Yaling Tao, Xiaoling Yu, Huaiwei Cong, Jinpeng Li, Junqi Zhu, Huaxin Ding, Qian Chen, Ting Cai
pmc-10937436.description: IntroductionThe tumor immune environment and immune-related genes are instrumental in the development, progression, and prognosis of bladder cancer (BLCA). This study sought to pinpoint key immune-related genes influencing BLCA prognosis and decipher their mechanisms of action.Methods and resultsWe analyzed differentially expressed genes (DEGs) between high- and low- tumor mutational burden (TMB) groups.

pmc-11387999.title: Hematologic Malignancies: Two Cases of a Rare Cause of Hypopituitarism
pmc-11387999.creator: Brian Lauzon, Tala Abu-Hijleh, Natalia McInnes, Ally Prebtani
pmc-11387999.description: Hematologic malignancies are rare causes of sellar masses and hypopituitarism. We report 2 cases of hypopituitarism due to sellar masses from hematologic malignancies. The first patient was found to have hypopituitarism but initial non-gadolinium-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) sella did not demonstrate a mass. Subsequent gadolinium-enhanced MRI and transsphenoidal biopsy confirmed a diagnosis of intravascular lymphoma.

pmc-11403778.title: Workplace violence against healthcare workers in the emergency department — a 10-year retrospective single-center cohort study
pmc-11403778.creator: Leo Benning, Gisbert W. Teepe, Jan Kleinekort, Jorun Thoma, Michael Clemens Röttger, Andrea Prunotto, Dominik Gottlieb, Stefan Klöppel, Hans-Jörg Busch, Felix P. Hans
pmc-11403778.description: BackgroundMedical staff are regularly confronted with workplace violence (WPV), which poses a threat to the safety of both staff and patients. Structured de-escalation training (DET) for Emergency Department (ED) staff has been shown to positively affect the reporting of WPV incidents and possibly reduce its impact.

pmc-11476420.title: Comparison and Determination of the Content of Mosapride Citrate by Different qNMR Methods
pmc-11476420.creator: Xiaofang Lian, Yiran Li, Limin Zuo, Xuejia Zhao, Huiyi Liu, Yongsheng Gu, Qingying Jia, Jing Yao, Guangzhi Shan, Koichi Kato, Gyula Batta
pmc-11476420.description: As a salt-type compound, mosapride citrate’s metabolism and side effects are correlated with its salt-forming ratio. Several techniques were developed in this work to compare various quantitative nuclear magnetic resonance (qNMR) methodologies and to quantitatively examine the content of raw materials. Among the qNMR techniques, methods for 1H NMR and 19F NMR were developed.

pmc-11667147.title: Torticollis as an early manifestation of basilar invagination in a paediatric patient
pmc-11667147.creator: Nehal Shata, Jumanah Ali, Nouf ALNosani, Ramsay MacNay
pmc-11667147.description: SummaryThis case report describes the clinical journey of a male patient in early childhood with developmental delay, failure to thrive, worsening right-sided head tilt torticollis and regression of motor skills with spasticity of the lower limbs. The case was complex due to the early onset and gradually worsening symptoms, including a decline in established motor milestones.

pmc-12448909.title: Integrating recombinase-based feedback and feedforward control for optimal resource decoupling
pmc-12448909.creator: Rixin Zhang, Rong Zhang, Xiao-Jun Tian
pmc-12448909.description: Resource competition disrupts circuit modularity by introducing unintended coupling between otherwise independent gene modules, thereby compromising genetic circuit function. While various control strategies have been explored, their complexity or limited efficacy have hindered broader application. Here, we present the Re-NF-FF-Controller, a recombinase-based strategy that integrates negative feedback and feedforward regulation via promoter flipping to mitigate resource competition.

pmc-12535003.title: The impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on all-cause mortality among oncological patients: a population-based study
pmc-12535003.creator: Kai Liu, XiaoHui Wang, Yubo Wang, Zhuoran Wang, Yao Zhao
pmc-12535003.description: BackgroundDuring the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic, COVID-19 was not the only threat to the health of patients with tumors. The response policy and the collapse of the health system also posed serious threats to patients with tumors. Our study aimed to quantify the changes in all-cause mortality among oncological patients in the United States during the COVID-19 pandemic.

pmc-12768779.title: PP74 Challenges And Potential Improvements In Policy Strategies For Prevention And Early Diagnosis Of Childhood Melanoma: A Patient Perspective
pmc-12768779.creator: Sonia Muñoz-López, Paula Closa, Pietro Refolo, Costanza Raimondi, Violeta Astratinei, Bettina Ryll, Joan Prades, Dario Sacchini, Josep Maria Borràs, Laura Sampietro-Colom
pmc-12768779.description: IntroductionTo design healthcare system strategies to inform policy decisions in prevention and early diagnosis of melanoma in children, adolescents, and young adults (CAYA) in Europe, a patient perspective is needed. The MELCAYA project addresses this issue, since this disease lacks preventive and diagnostic strategies.

pmc-12793841.title: Significance of Clinical and Genetic Signatures of Familial Hypercholesterolemia Among Patients With Severe Hypercholesterolemia
pmc-12793841.creator: Hayato Tada, Atsushi Nohara, Soichiro Usui, Kenji Sakata, Masa-aki Kawashiri, Masayuki Takamura
pmc-12793841.description: BackgroundFamilial hypercholesterolemia (FH) is diagnosed based on clinical signs of FH, including family history and/or xanthomas, or pathogenic FH-variant.ObjectivesThe authors aimed to clarify whether these signatures are associated with coronary artery disease (CAD) events beyond low density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol level among patients with severe hypercholesterolemia.

pmc-12960856.title: Simple and reliable method for predicting extracorporeal membrane oxygenation flow rates and circuit pressures
pmc-12960856.creator: Kazuhiro Takahashi, Seiga Takahashi, Yusuke Takei, Yu Kaiho, Takahiro Imaizumi, Kenji Kikuchi, Takuji Ishikawa, Yutaka Ejima, Masanori Yamauchi
pmc-12960856.description: BackgroundVenovenous extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) is essential for patients with severe respiratory failure who do not respond to conventional mechanical ventilation. Adequate ECMO flow and safe circuit pressure are critical; however, cannula selection, which has a great impact on these factors, is often based on empirical judgment.

pmc-13219575.title: An aqueous in situ approach to discover crystalline coordination materials for adsorptive separation
pmc-13219575.creator: Qingqing Yan, Chenyang Nie, Yafei Du, Bochun Zhang, Yi Cheng, Peng Guo, Sujing Wang
pmc-13219575.description: Coordination materials are pivotal for advancing multidisciplinary science. Conventional synthetic methods, solid-, liquid-, and gas-phase, suffer from limited reactant scope and poor control over product formation, hindering fundamental research and applications. Here, we introduce a heterogeneous in situ approach using zero-valent metals as cation sources in water, combined with linker supersaturation.

pmc-13234721.title: Engaging communities in recovery: Evaluation of a patient and family advisory committee supporting implementation of the Road to Recovery model of substance use care in British Columbia
pmc-13234721.creator: David Chang, Seonaid Nolan, Jeffrey Morgan, Andrea Ryan, Clint Barton, Robert Chippeway, Nichola Hall, Colin Gregory, Erika Mundel, Travis De Wolfe, Cheyenne Johnson, Brittany B Dennis
pmc-13234721.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThe increasing presence of unpredictable toxic substances in the drug supply has intensified the need for substance use care models that integrate lived and living experience into program design and implementation. The Road to Recovery (R2R) initiative, launched in British Columbia in 2023, established a Patient and Family Advisory Committee (PFAC) to ensure clinical services and research processes reflect patient and family priorities. This study provides an early evaluation of the PFAC embedded within the R2R model.MethodsA convergent mixed-methods design was used.

pmc-13246562.title: Different types of sensory nerve endings in the urinary bladder of mice arising from dorsal root ganglia (DRG) at the thoracolumbar region of vertebral column
pmc-13246562.creator: Nick J Spencer, Melinda A Kyloh, Lee Travis, Vladimir P Zagorodnyuk, Luke Grundy, Tim Hibberd
pmc-13246562.description: The urinary bladder is innervated by two anatomically distinct populations of sensory neurons originating from dorsal root ganglia (DRG): one from the thoracolumbar (TL) and another from the lumbosacral (LS) spinal region. While we previously characterized the morphology and distribution of sensory endings arising from LS DRG, the terminals of TL afferents remain undefined.

pmc-13503414.creator: Ying Feng, Hua-Hua Liu, Liu-Cheng Li, Kai-Li Mao, Xiao-Fang Niu, Jie Hu
pmc-13503414.description: Oral anticoagulants (OAC) are effective in thrombo-embolic disorders, but their real-world bleeding profiles in hypertensive versus non-hypertensive users remain unknown. This study provides an exploratory, real-world assessment of the population-level, agent-specific safety hierarchy of direct OAC (DOACs; apixaban, dabigatran, edoxaban, rivaroxaban) and warfarin.

pmc-13552171.title: Pediatric Cervical Spine Aneurysmal Bone Cyst with Recurrent Atlantoaxial Rotatory Subluxation Requiring C1–C2 Fusion: A 7-Year Follow-Up Case Report
pmc-13552171.creator: Reyaz Ahmed, Abhishek Raina, Nasir Shah, Sumit Kumar, Amber Agarwal, Anirudh Dwajan
pmc-13552171.description: Introduction:Aneurysmal bone cysts (ABCs) of the cervical spine in children are rare, locally aggressive lesions that may compromise spinal stability. Atlantoaxial rotatory subluxation (AARS) is an uncommon association and is typically related to trauma or infection. The coexistence of ABC with AARS, particularly with recurrence of instability after tumor resolution, is extremely rare and presents unique diagnostic and therapeutic challenges.

pmc-13573523.title: Could creatine supplementation combined with physical rehabilitation accelerate return to play in athletes with patellar tendinopathy?
pmc-13573523.creator: Ángela Sánchez-Gómez, Marco Malaguti, Borja Sañudo, Álvaro López-Samanes, Alejandro F. San Juan, Raúl Domínguez
pmc-13573523.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). However, to date, no studies have specifically examined the effects of scientifically supported ergogenic aids on recovery outcomes when combined with physical performance interventions.

uslaw-usc-t15-s3002.title: 15 U.S.C. § 3002 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t15-s3002.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s3002.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 57 (Interstate Horseracing). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. For the purposes of this chapter the term— (1) “person” means any individual, association, partnership, joint venture, corporation, State or political subdivision thereof, department, agency, or instrumentality of a State or political subdivision thereof, or any other organization or entity; (2) “State” means each State.
